Marta Rojas: scheduling a config-only change for tonight's change window at 23:00 UTC. small routing weight nudge + reduce max_batch_ms from 40 -> 30, increase per-route timeout from 6s -> 8s (to avoid premature tail kills). Canaries: 2% -> 10% -> 100% unless regressions. PR/notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/PR-4987
DevDeployBot: deploy plan created: id=deploy-4987; canary steps [2%,10%,100%]; auto-rollback on error-rate >0.5% or p95_latency increase >20% for 5m. Scheduled start 2024-07-02T23:00Z. CI checks passed: config-lint ok.
Jason K.: what's the exact routing key change? are we pinning model versions? worried about cross-region pin fallout.
Marta Rojas: routing: route-policy: prefer-lower-cost-variant weight +3% for model-llama-q4; no version pinning — we'll rely on compatibility matrix. If we see mismatch we will pin to model-llama-q4-v2 and roll forward.
Lucas W.: prefix cache invalidation? changing weights might expose colder kv cache -> surge of token cost.
Marta Rojas: good point. no global cache flush. we'll enable prefix-KV warmup with 10m prefetch on canary hosts. batch reduction to 30ms to reduce queueing.
Rachel (oncall): I'm on-call for that window. I can monitor SLO dashboard and rollback if p95 > 1.2s sustained 10m. keep me posted in #incidents.
Priya S.: suggest starting at 1% then 5% then 20% - less risk. also add more granular obs: per-model p50/p95/p99 and per-customer error spikes. :thumbsup: 
Marta Rojas: ok switching to 1/5/20/100 ramp. thresholds: error-rate >0.3% OR p95 increase >15% vs baseline (5m window) triggers hold; >0.6% or p95 >25% triggers rollback. rollforward requires 30m stable at 20%.
DevDeployBot: canary ramp updated: [1%,5%,20%,100%]. watchers: Rachel (oncall). rollback_conditions set. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rb-config-canary
Jason K.: will post quick release note blurb in product: "routing weight update, batching timeout tweak, cache-warm up" — sku change? no.
Marta Rojas: deploying to canary in ~20m. ping this thread immediately if you see anything odd. TL;DR: config-only, small routing nudge, batch_ms 40->30, max_inflight unchanged, timeout 6->8s, canary ramp 1/5/20/100, autorollback rules set.
DevDeployBot: deploy started: deploy-4987 step=canary-1% at 2024-07-02T22:58:20Z
Rachel (oncall): watching dashboards now.
Lucas W.: logs: seeing small spike in cache misses on canary hosts, not yet impacting latency.
Marta Rojas: noted. warming task kicked. hold for 10m then ramp to 5% if stable.
DevDeployBot: canary progressed to 5% at 2024-07-02T23:12:05Z
Priya S.: no customer-facing regressions on synthetic tests. agree to proceed.
DevDeployBot: canary progressed to 20% at 2024-07-02T23:28:40Z
Jason K.: all green from my side. go 100% in 10 minutes unless objections.
Marta Rojas: proceeding to 100% in 10.
DevDeployBot: deploy completed to 100% at 2024-07-02T23:40:11Z — SUCCESS
Marta Rojas: thanks everyone. will keep monitoring for 2 hours.
